parallelism.residual_stream: Replicated at decoder layer input/output boundaries.
collectives: TP all_reduce after shared expert down projection
EP then TP all_reduce after routed MoE output
rejected_alternatives: 2D activation sharding at layer boundaries: rejected because it would require distributed RMSNorm plus all-gather before every current full-hidden projection or a wider rewrite of all projection contracts.
KV-head replication instead of TP sharding: rejected because the model has exactly two KV heads and a 2-column split gives one KV head per device while preserving paged-cache semantics.

Physical expert-weight sharding across EP rows: rejected for this stage because TTNN sparse_matmul is driven by a global expert axis; moe_routing_remap partitions selected sparse rows across EP rows while routed expert weights remain replicated across rows.
Dense/all-expert routed MoE prefill: rejected because the completed multichip path must keep gate-selected active-expert execution.
Delayed sharded-residual families: rejected in doc/multichip_decoder/residual_topology_audit.md because current residual add, RMSNorm, and projection contracts consume full hidden width.
